title: Human refuses the budget override: execute the within-budget fallback and own the residual risk
description: Same position as s4_budget_binding, but the category manager rejects the 714-unit override. The agent must not ask again or escalate in a loop. It replans to the best option that needs no override (342 units, within budget, auto-approvable), executes and validates it, and reports the stockout on day 7 that the human knowingly accepted.
rationale: own requirement identical to s4_budget_binding: net 710 -> 714; the full buy needs BUDGET_OVERRIDE + OVER_AUTO_LIMIT approval; the approver sees A (714, 2,141,200 over budget, no stockout) vs B (342, stockout day 7)
human REJECTS the override -> option A is removed (a refused option is never re-proposed) -> replan 1
best remaining option is B: floor(2,000,000 / 5,800) = 344 -> floor to case 6 = 342; 342 x 5,800 = 1,983,600 COP <= 2,000,000 (16,400 left)
B needs no approval: primary supplier, within budget, 1,983,600 < auto limit 3,000,000, constraints pass -> executes automatically
pre-action validate_po passes (MOQ 120 <= 342, 342 = 57 cases of 6, storage free 2160, budget ok) -> submit -> CONFIRMED
outcome check: projection with 342 arriving day 2 = d0 170, d1 90, d2 352, d3 272, d4 192, d5 112, d6 32, d7 -48, d8 -128

the realised projection matches the option's prediction (stockout day 7, 128 unmet), and that stockout is the risk the human accepted by refusing A -> no replan; the run completes and the decision records residual_risk {stockout_day: 7, unmet_units: 128}
nothing above 342 units may be persisted after the rejection
